prompt: A DNS Jail (chroot) or DNS Cage is the model in which:
choices: The DNS server only answers recursive queries.
The DNS server operates in an environment isolated from the rest of the system.
The DNS server shares its zone files with all other daemons.
The DNS server runs entirely in kernel space.
explanation: A DNS jail or cage runs the name server in an isolated chroot environment, separated from the rest of the filesystem and system.
